mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which can lead to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 6-month moving average signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 6-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals increased consumer spending, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
